verdict.rationale: LM Studio lets users attach documents to chat messages and ask questions about them entirely offline (built-in RAG since 0.3.0), with any local model. That delivers AI-generated insights from the user's own data inside the app. A community user corroborates the RAG capability, and Bionic adds agent-assisted document creation and editing. Missing for 10: proactive or automatic insights and suggestions without explicit prompting, in-depth documentation of RAG behavior and limits, and hands-on independent evidence of insight quality on user data.
